args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com. It's clean and minimal, and I like that your contact email is easy to find right away. One suggestion: since it's currently just a short intro and your email, you could make it more engaging by adding an "About Me" section, some photos, or links to your projects and social profiles. A little more content would help visitors get to know you better. Thanks for sharing, and welcome to Slack!

A few ideas to take it further: consider adding trail guides or route descriptions, photos from your hikes, gear recommendations, and a regular posting schedule to keep readers coming back. It's a solid start, and with a bit more content it could become a go-to resource for hiking enthusiasts. Keep it up!
